_comment: NotebookLM stamps two wordmarks plus a full-frame end card. Boxes are NORMALISED (fractions of frame size) because render resolution varies: the supplied sample frames were 1600x900 while the real render came back 1280x720. Plate colour is NOT configured - it is sampled per segment from the frame behind the mark, because the background is (250,250,250) grey for most of the video, white on the title and closing cards, and full-bleed orange (252,138,0) on every section-transition slide.
_geometry_comment: The box is the MINIMAL footprint of the original mark plus about 2px of pad, not a larger area sized to suit our logo. An opaque plate destroys whatever is behind it, and on the title card a wider box visibly cut through an orange decoration bar. logo_height_ratio then lets our logo render taller than the plate and overhang onto untouched background - it has an alpha channel, so overhanging costs nothing while the destroyed rectangle stays as small as possible.

bottom_right._comment: Persistent wordmark, whole video. Measured on a 1600x900 sample: x=1384..1539 y=830..845. Left edge held at 0.8625 because in another sample the word 'goals' ends at 0.8606 and the mark starts at 0.8650 - the only safe gap.

centre_top._comment: Second wordmark on the opening title card only. Measured on the real 1280x720 render: x=543..722 y=99..118, present t=0-7s. Height covers to y=121 at 720p: at h=0.0320 the plate stopped at y=117 and left a single row of the mark's descender visible at y=118. The window is re-measured per video at frame rate and clamped to the following slide cut.
